product.name: AI WhatsApp Sales/RM Agent
product.description: An AI-powered WhatsApp relationship-manager agent for real estate leads. It responds to inbound property inquiries instantly, maintains conversation context, answers questions about listings/projects, qualifies buyer requirements, handles common objections, and books site visits or demos, escalating to a human agent when needed.
product.problem_solved: Real estate developers and brokerages lose 70-80% of inbound leads because average response time is 4-6 hours and 68% of inquiries arrive after business hours, when no RM is available to respond.
differentiators: Instant 24/7 WhatsApp response, closing the after-hours response gap
Maintains one unified conversation context per lead across channels
Qualifies and books site visits without human involvement for routine inquiries
